x: Herne Hill Harriers' success in the Surrey County Relay event is due to the fact that they have in their ranks two very fine athletes, Pallett and Pell.

With Pell running for Herne Hill, and Eeles for Southgate, also Williams of Poly., our chances of beating these clubs were slight. To make matters worse, at the last moment Eddie Pack was forced to cry off, and so Fred White had to be asked to do the 440.
